quarterly_data.signal: GlobalWafers says its Novara (Italy) plant, hit by a fire in the 8-inch line on July 20, has partially resumed production, slightly ahead of the original recovery plan: all key facility systems are back in operation, some front-end processes have resumed, and the epitaxial (EPI) process restarted ahead of the wafering line, with the first batch of products processed and shipping. Back-end processes directly hit by the fire are still being rebuilt and are being supported by other group sites; because the supporting sites were already running at full utilization and some newly purchased equipment has long lead times, Novara's capacity and revenue cannot fully recover immediately, and capacity and output are expected to rise gradually as customer qualifications complete. The plant carries property insurance covering property damage and business-interruption losses, with claims in progress. The newly built 12-inch expansion line was not affected: construction is complete and customer qualification and mass-production introduction are progressing.
quarterly_data.figure: Novara partially restarted; EPI first products shipping; full recovery not immediate
